description: Implementation of AutomotiveDisplayProxyService class, providing methods to manage automotive display buffers, show/hide windows, and retrieve display info.

classes.name: AutomotiveDisplayProxyService
classes.description: Service class providing display buffer management and display info retrieval for automotive displays.

methods.name: getIGraphicBufferProducer
methods.description: Retrieves the graphic buffer producer interface for a given display ID.

methods.name: showWindow
methods.description: Shows the display window for a given display ID.

methods.name: hideWindow
methods.description: Hides the display window for a given display ID.

methods.name: getDisplayIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available display IDs.

methods.name: getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display configuration and state information for a given display ID.
